text:
Staying at a Hakone ryokan with dinner?
Ours closed check-in at 18:00.
On a December Wednesday, we'd leave
Shinjuku at 15:00. Here's why 👇

💴 Full timings 👉 https://japanbystation.com/hakone-ryokan-dinner-leave-tokyo

🚃 Plan A: go straight there
Take the 15:00 Romancecar from Shinjuku.
It reaches Hakone-Yumoto at 16:25.
Change to the 16:27 mountain train.
You're in Gora by 17:03.
💴 ¥2,871 by IC card, seat included.
📞 Our sample ryokan is 850 m uphill from Gora.
Call them after 15:30 and they pick you up.
⚠️ Missed the 15:00? The 15:21 express
has two changes and reaches Gora at 17:48.
Tight, but it works.

🗿 Plan B: add a museum
Take the 10:00 Romancecar instead.
Stop at the Hakone Open-Air Museum,
one station before Gora.
🎟️ ¥2,000 at the door, ¥1,800 online.
⏰ Trains to Gora: 16:31, 16:47 and 17:01.
After that, nothing until 17:31.
So leave the museum by 16:50.

🌙 Plan C: stuck in Tokyo until evening
Don't pay for a dinner you'll miss.
Book a room-only hotel near Hakone-Yumoto.
Ours was ¥16,800 for two, 150 m from the station.
The 18:00 Romancecar arrives at 19:40.
🔥 A charcoal grill 2 minutes away
takes last orders at 21:30 (closed Mondays).

✅ Our take
Ryokan dinner? Be on the 15:00.
Free morning? Take the 10:00 and see the museum.
Leaving late? Room only in Yumoto.

👉 The onsen that works on a room-only night:
https://japanbystation.com/hakone-ryokan-dinner-leave-tokyo
